title: Purposes and terms of investments.
bodyText:
(a) Investments may be used for any purpose consistent with the purposes and objectives of this part.

(b) Investments may be made on such terms and conditions as the development corporation shall determine to be reasonable, appropriate, and consistent with the purposes and objectives of this part.
bodyHtml:
[§206M-79]  Purposes and terms of investments.  (a)  Investments may be used for any purpose consistent with the purposes and objectives of this part.

     (b)  Investments may be made on such terms and conditions as the development corporation shall determine to be reasonable, appropriate, and consistent with the purposes and objectives of this part. [L 2019, c 56, pt of §2]
